problem_statement: The DNS resolver should signal that its server configuration has been refreshed whenever a reconfigure succeeds. Today, when dns_resolve_reconfigure() is called with a server set identical to the one already configured, the per-slot DNS_SERVER_ADD and DNS_SERVER_DEL events are intentionally suppressed (to avoid cancelling in-flight queries on DHCP-offer retransmit and IPv6 RA), so a consumer that wants to know "the DNS configuration is ready again" after a network event receives no signal at all for that reconfigure. There should be a NET_MGMT_EVENT that is raised on every successful reconfigure — including the deduplicated case — but is NOT raised by the init path, so a consumer can gate on it as a "DNS configuration is ready" indicator.
